receipt_order_after_actual_adoption: exact future actual Info literal FileRef

qualified_support_changes.change_in_new_successor_only: Add exact INFO_LITERAL_RECEIPT and INFO_LITERAL_CONTEXT FileRef constants only after real root-reviewed files exist. Detect the literal Info path in the configuration, manifest environment, and extension receipt list; reject mismatched hashes, omission, or the Info context without its receipt. Permit the exact second receipt only for RIEMANN-INTERFACE-FLUX/Q7 and the reviewed unchanged InfoCERT target. Reject its use for FV, DIM, or another row. Preserve the existing Eq1.10-only and DIM literal branches byte-for-byte in behavior, and reject mixing DIM and Info addenda.

Extend the no-context-reference omission guard to the Info receipt path in both configuration and manifest, as for the DIM receipt. All three source-context references remain paired and mandatory whenever the Info context is configured.

If a new local preparer is adopted, append only its reviewed actual SHA/name to SOURCE_CONTEXT_PREPARERS. Retain exact pointer/content/receipt bytes, source PDF, original-primary locator predecessor, image order/hash/environment uniqueness, target/source hashes, current native provenance, and prior_decisions_reused=false checks. Do not weaken the scope_rule. No added allowlist entry is necessary if the existing preparer and an exact root-reviewed preflight are reused.

No semantic change is needed: append_source_context_contract already records all three exact context/packet/lineage references, complete extension JSON, and every literal receipt's exact text and hash. Keep unextended and existing extended row contracts unchanged. Test that the new receipt is retained with its own authority and that Q7 and Eq1.10 text are unchanged.

source_preparer_changes.observation: The existing exact seven-field schema already accepts multiple literal receipts and verifies their source, actual question-item shape, answer, scope, authority limit, adopted clauses, preservation list, exact bytes and FileRefs. It also checks page images against the actual source-rendering directory.
source_preparer_changes.proposal: In an additive local successor or separate reviewed preflight, require the exact Info row/Q7/target/context/receipt tuple before any fresh task files are created. Require the old Eq1.10 receipt first, the actual reviewed Info receipt second, and no others. Pin unchanged native supplement/target. Keep all existing loader validations. No generic or released schema expansion is required.

If deriving a successor, neutral wording such as 'separate exact scoped interpretation receipts' can replace the blanket inherited-receipt label for the new Info route; it must not blend the authorities. Preserve source-only extraction, blind target isolation, exact image hashes, judge-only interpretation evidence, actual lineage and new transport preflight. No completed decision or rationale belongs in role inputs. The current no-inference scope rule can remain exact.

downstream_pin_updates_when_implemented: Derive new bind-qualified-row and ordinary closed-row validator from v4/v7 with the exact new support import/hash; do not change old files.

If final context refresh/global evidence binding is required, derive compatible rebind-accepted-row-batch-v3, validate-closed-row-audits-rebind-v3 and bind-final-global-evidence-v3 successors or reviewed explicit dependencies. They currently refer to q4/v7. Preserve accepted row semantics and complete validation requirements.
Regenerate only future actual request/validator dependency manifests. Existing audit inputs, decisions, requests and helper pins remain frozen. No gate execution is part of this proposal.
required_guard_tests_not_run_here: Existing Eq1.10-only supported rows produce unchanged contracts and validation results.
Existing exact DIM literal context and its complete contract remain unchanged.
Exact new Info context with an actual root-reviewed receipt passes structural validation, without asserting acceptance.
Missing, null, placeholder, reordered, duplicate, mutated or unconfigured Info receipt fails.
Info receipt in FV/DIM/another row, wrong Q-choice or different target fails.
Mixed Info and DIM literal receipts fail.
Configured or manifested Info receipt with omitted three context references fails.
Changed receipt text versus packet exact bytes/fields fails even if labels agree.
Changed PDF, page-25 bytes, image order, primary locator, old Eq1.10 receipt or selected Q7 receipt fails.
Unreviewed preparer hash, stale native environment, changed target or source-context lineage fails.
Nonoperational template envelopes cannot be submitted as source context or audit spec.
Unaccepted or incomplete audit still fails ordinary accepted-row binding, irrespective of valid receipts.
